source.stem: What is the correct sequence for blood being pumped from the heart to the lungs?

options.text: left atrium → left ventricle → pulmonary artery
left atrium → left ventricle → pulmonary vein
right atrium → right ventricle → pulmonary artery
right atrium → right ventricle → pulmonary vein

mx.teacher_note: Stomata occur only on the lower surface of leaves.

intelligence.enrichment: Tiny pores called stomata are present on leaf surfaces and help in gas exchange; during photosynthesis, leaves exchange carbon dioxide and oxygen. Stomata on leaf surface -> pathway for exchange of carbon dioxide and oxygen during photosynthesis. The learner correctly applies this rule: Tiny pores called stomata are present on leaf surfaces and help in gas exchange; during photosynthesis, leaves exchange carbon dioxide and oxygen. Tiny pores on a leaf are just holes for water movement, not gas exchange structures.
